responsibility: Stage two. Turn stored raw payloads into one normalized, feature-complete row per candidate app: parse and reconcile fields across sources, then compute complexity_score, estimated sales (Boxleiter band), gross/net revenue and effort-adjusted return. Writes games_enriched and game_tags.
design_notes: Pure transformation over database state. No network access, so the stage is fully re-runnable for an existing run_id after a parameter change.
Every constant comes from EnrichmentParams, which mirrors FORMULATION.md. A literal number in a formula is a spec violation.
Every derived row is stamped with parameters_version so a score can be traced to the constants that produced it.
All derived quantities are modelled estimates, not measurements. Sales and revenue are emitted as low/mid/high bands, never as a single authoritative figure.

public_interface.name: parse_raw_bundle
public_interface.signature: def parse_raw_bundle(conn: sqlite3.Connection, run_id: str) -> RawBundle
public_interface.description: Streams raw_games for the run and groups payloads per appid across sources.

public_interface.name: normalize_features
public_interface.description: Flattens raw payloads into the base feature frame: identity, price, review counts, owners band, size_bytes, achievement_count, language_count, platform_count, dlc_count, early access flags, deck compatibility, genres, categories. Records which fields were absent.

public_interface.name: extract_tags
public_interface.signature: def extract_tags(bundle: RawBundle, *, max_tags_per_game: int, min_votes: int) -> list[TagRow]
public_interface.description: Normalizes tag dictionaries into (appid, tag, votes, rank) rows for game_tags.

public_interface.name: compute_developer_catalog_size
public_interface.signature: def compute_developer_catalog_size(frame: pd.DataFrame, catalog: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series
public_interface.description: Counts other titles by the same developer. Counted against the full SteamSpy catalog snapshot, not only against the candidate set, otherwise a prolific studio filtered out at stage one looks like a first-time solo developer.

public_interface.name: compute_complexity_score
public_interface.signature: def compute_complexity_score(frame: pd.DataFrame, tags: pd.DataFrame, params: EnrichmentParams) -> tuple[pd.Series, pd.DataFrame]
public_interface.description: Implements FORMULATION.md section 4. Returns the clipped [0,1] score plus a per-feature contribution frame for explainability in the UI. Missing features are imputed at the cohort median and flagged, never treated as zero.

public_interface.name: estimate_sales
public_interface.signature: def estimate_sales(review_count: pd.Series, genre_bucket: pd.Series, params: EnrichmentParams) -> pd.DataFrame
public_interface.description: Implements FORMULATION.md section 2. Returns columns estimated_sales_low/mid/high.

public_interface.name: map_genre_bucket
public_interface.signature: def map_genre_bucket(genres: pd.Series, params: EnrichmentParams) -> pd.Series
public_interface.description: Maps Steam genre lists onto the multiplier buckets. Unmatched genres fall to the documented default bucket and are counted.

public_interface.name: estimate_revenue
public_interface.signature: def estimate_revenue(sales: pd.DataFrame, price_usd: pd.Series, params: EnrichmentParams) -> pd.DataFrame
public_interface.description: Implements FORMULATION.md section 3. Returns gross and net columns. Free-to-play rows follow the approved F2P policy (open question), not a silent zero.

public_interface.name: compute_effort_adjusted_return
public_interface.signature: def compute_effort_adjusted_return(net_revenue: pd.Series, complexity: pd.Series, params: EnrichmentParams) -> pd.Series

public_interface.name: build_enriched_frame
public_interface.signature: def build_enriched_frame(bundle: RawBundle, catalog: pd.DataFrame, params: EnrichmentParams) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, list[TagRow]]
public_interface.description: Composes the whole stage as a pure function, for direct unit testing from fixtures.

public_interface.name: run_enrichment
public_interface.signature: def run_enrichment(conn: sqlite3.Connection, run_id: str, params: EnrichmentParams, *, parameters_version: str, on_event: EventSink) -> EnrichmentReport
public_interface.description: Stage entry point. Reads raw_games, writes games_enriched and game_tags, emits progress events.

invariants: No numeric constant appears in code; all come from EnrichmentParams
complexity_score is in [0, 1] for every written row, or NULL if too many inputs were missing to be meaningful
estimated_sales_low <= estimated_sales_mid <= estimated_sales_high for every row
Rows whose app_type is not 'game' are dropped and counted, not silently included
Re-running the stage for the same run_id replaces prior rows transactionally and is idempotent for identical parameters
Review count is taken from the Steam reviews endpoint when available and from SteamSpy only as a fallback; the source used is recorded
edge_cases: review_count == 0 -> estimated sales 0; effort_adjusted_return 0; row is kept (it still informs competition density)
price_usd == 0 (free-to-play) -> revenue per the approved F2P policy; must not silently become 0 revenue if the policy is 'unknown'
complexity_score == 0 -> guarded by effort_epsilon so effort_adjusted_return stays finite
size_bytes, achievement_count or languages missing from appdetails -> imputed at cohort median and flagged in imputed_features_json
More than a configured share of a row's complexity features missing -> complexity_score NULL, row excluded from simplicity ranking but kept for density
Partial or non-numeric release_date -> stored as-is plus a parsed date where possible; unparseable dates exclude the row from trend analysis only
Unmatched genre -> default multiplier bucket, counted in unmatched_genre_count
Duplicate appid across sources -> single row; source precedence documented
Empty candidate set (candidate_count == 0) -> stage succeeds writing zero rows
NaN / inf guards after every division and log transform; no NaN may reach the database silently

unit: estimate_sales reproduces hand-computed values for a fixed multiplier table, including the low <= mid <= high ordering
estimate_revenue reproduces hand-computed gross and net values for known price, discount and cut
compute_complexity_score returns exactly the weighted sum for a synthetic row with known normalized features
complexity clipping holds at both extremes (all-min and all-max feature rows give 0 and 1)
median imputation is applied and flagged for missing features, and zero is never substituted
map_genre_bucket routes unmatched genres to the default bucket and counts them
effort_adjusted_return stays finite when complexity_score is 0
free-to-play rows follow the configured policy
non-game app_types are dropped with the correct reason tally
the stage is idempotent: two consecutive runs over the same raw data produce identical frames
integration: run_enrichment over a fixture database produces the expected games_enriched and game_tags contents

non_goals: No filtering by simplicity threshold (that is analysis)
open_questions: F2P handling policy (exclude vs. revenue-unknown) — blocks estimate_revenue
Whether complexity normalization bounds are calibrated empirically from the first run's percentiles and then frozen, or fixed a priori
Whether owners_estimate is used in any derived score at all, given its low confidence, or shown as a display-only column
